metadata.title: Monochromatic Surrealist Album Art with Root System

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, split-horizon composition featuring a leafless tree with an expansive, glowing root system and a circular halo of figures.
triggerTerms: circular arrangement of figures around a tree
excludeWhen: minimalist flat vector art is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, square composition divided horizontally into a light upper half and a dark lower half. A central leafless tree bridges the two, with its branches reaching into the light and its intricate, lightning-like roots descending into the dark. A ring of small, top-down figures orbits the tree crown, while a red Roman numeral is embedded in the root core.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry centered on the tree trunk
Horizontal division between light sky and dark earth
Circular orbit of figures relative to the tree crown
Contrast between organic branch silhouettes and chaotic root filaments
coreInvariants: The central tree must have a leafless, antler-like branch structure.
The root system must be significantly more complex and expansive than the branches.
A thin red border must frame the entire central square composition.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The tree is centrally located, spanning the full height of the inner frame; the root system occupies the bottom 50%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central tree trunk and the glowing red focal point within the roots.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central tree, move upward to the circular ring of figures, then descend through the trunk into the complex root network.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the upper half provides breathing room for the figure ring.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson Red (central numeral and outer border)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero saturation except for the singular red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Glow effect emanating from the strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'I' and 'V' are formed by thickened, glowing root filaments.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single symbolic element integrated into the illustration.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, rough texture of the tree and roots.
Allows for the necessary integration into the root filaments.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square monochromatic illustration with a split horizon. The top half is white with a leafless tree and a ring of 15 small human figures seen from above. The bottom half is black with a massive, intricate white root system. Add a thin red border around the square.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the center of the root system, add a glowing red Roman numeral 'IV' using a distressed, hand-drawn style that blends into the surrounding root filaments.

verificationChecks: Is the horizon line clearly defined?
Are the roots significantly more detailed than the branches?
Is the red numeral centered within the root mass?
Does the red border frame the entire square?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the circular ring
mustRedesign: Avoid using standard digital fonts for the central numeral; it must look like part of the roots.
Do not use smooth gradients; maintain a stippled or grainy texture.

mustAchieve: Consistent stippled texture across all elements
avoid: Multiple colors beyond the red accent

postGenerationChecks: Check that the figures are oriented correctly in a circle.
Ensure the root system looks like lightning or neural pathways.
Verify the red border is thin and perfectly square.
Confirm the central numeral is legible but integrated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-horizon monochrome + central organic subject + circular secondary elements + single-color glowing focal point.
